title: The Backpack
lines: Tom is off to camp with his pal Dan.
He packs his backpack with a hotdog and napkin.
Dan's kitten is hidden in the backpack.
Tom cannot see it, and off they go.
Tom and Dan hop up the big hill.
At the top they sit and rest.
At sunset Tom digs for his hotdog.
The kitten is sitting on it! Tom is upset.
The hotdog is a mess. The napkin is wet.
Dan hands him a muffin and Tom grins.
The kitten naps as they sit in the sun.

questions.listenFor: A hotdog, a napkin, and Dan's kitten. Stated in the story - have them find the lines instead of listing it for them.
The kitten sat on his hotdog and made it a mess. If they only say "the kitten," ask "and what did the kitten do?"

questions.ask: How do you think the kitten got in the backpack? Tell me why.
questions.listenFor: Any answer is fine. Listen for a reason tied to the story - the hotdog was in there, and nobody was looking.
